tests.name: Collision constants, HF centrality boundaries, and Glauber <N_part>
tests.explanation: All collision constants (sqrt(s_NN) = 2.76 TeV, reference L_int = 6.7 ub^-1), dijet kinematic thresholds (pT1 > 120 GeV, pT2 > 50 GeV, |eta| < 2.0, dphi12 > 2pi/3, A_J < 0.15, dphi12 > 3.026), HF centrality boundaries (max rounding difference 4.69e-07 TeV), and Table 2 Glauber <N_part> +/- syst values (max |diff| = 0) match CMS-HIN-10-004.

tests.name: Event selection cutflow step efficiencies and scaled dijet yield

cleaning_substeps.filter_config: HiEcalRecHitSpikeFilter (EcalRecHitsEB, minEt=20.0 GeV, swissThreshold=0.95, timeThreshold=4.0 ns, avoidIeta85=False)

tests.explanation: Across 2,154 Golden-JSON HICorePhysics files (66 runs), adding HiEcalRecHitSpikeFilter eliminates fake barrel-edge spike mono-jets and brings the high-pT dijet selection steps into agreement with CMS Table 1: subleading pT2 > 50 GeV is 87.16% vs 87.38% (-0.26 sigma), dphi12 > 2pi/3 is 94.80% vs 95.39% (-0.96 sigma), leading pT1 > 120 GeV is 5.46% vs 5.86% (-2.84 sigma), and the HLT-scaled final dijet yield is 3590 +/- 83 vs 3514 (+0.92 sigma; cleaned-scaled 3662 +/- 84, +1.75 sigma). However, four earlier intermediate step efficiencies remain >3 sigma inconsistent (max |pull| = 39.14 sigma): HF coincidence (78.43% vs 74.69%, +20.17 sigma) and primary vertex (95.47% vs 98.97%, -39.14 sigma) shift inversely due to omitting the BSC halo veto and >=3-tower HF coincidence; combined noise/scraping cleaning is 94.28% vs 97.42% (-29.25 sigma); and >=2 jets pT > 35 GeV is 75.63% vs 67.07% (+36.80 sigma) under Spring10_HI L2L3 JEC. Separating the cleaning sub-steps shows HCAL+scraping given ECAL (99.97% vs 99.97% HCAL cleaning, -0.47 sigma; +12.56 sigma vs 99.75% beam-gas*HCAL due to omitted pixel cluster compatibility) matches HCAL cleaning, whereas HiEcalRecHitSpikeFilter (minEt=20 GeV) retains 94.31% vs Table 1's 97.66% (-31.57 sigma) because vetoing whole events on 20-50 GeV barrel APD spikes removes random multiplicity-correlated soft spikes in central PbPb collisions.

tests.name: HLT_HIJet50U single-jet trigger turn-on curve (PRC Fig. 2a / Open Data Fig. 1a)
tests.explanation: Rebinned onto the exact common 12-bin grid over [20, 160] GeV by summing exact binomial (k, n) counts from CmsHI/CVS_CmsHi TrigEffCorrected151058and151025.C (PRC Fig. 2a), the Open Data turn-on curve agrees across the turn-on rise and 100% plateau with chi2/ndf = 6.34/12 = 0.528 (p = 0.898), maximum single-bin pull +1.30 sigma ([70, 80] GeV, Fisher p = 0.068; min Fisher p = 0.050), and plateau efficiency 99.983% (5829/5830) for pT1 in [100, 160] GeV vs 100.0% (54/54) in runs 151058+151025.

tests.name: Forward calorimeter sum E_HF shape in HLT_HIJet50U events (PRC Fig. 3a)
tests.explanation: Unit-normalized over [0, 160] TeV on identical 70-bin histograms (55 populated bins in [0.0, 125.7] TeV), the Open Data HLT_HIJet50U sum E_HF distribution (N = 55,048) agrees with hhfJET (N = 4,599 in hf_centrality_distribution_mb_jet50_20101126_v1.C): chi2/ndf = 57.93/54 = 1.073 (p = 0.332, 0.97 sigma), ratio slope (-8.7 +/- 4.9)e-4 TeV^-1 (-1.77 sigma), and <sum E_HF> = 69.34 TeV vs 70.50 TeV.

tests.name: Forward calorimeter sum E_HF shape in Minimum-Bias events (PRC Fig. 3a)
tests.explanation: Across the 55 populated bins [0.0, 125.7] TeV, the Open Data Minimum-Bias sum E_HF distribution (N = 14,255) yields chi2/ndf = 102.84/54 = 1.904 (p = 6.97e-05, 3.98 sigma) and a negative ratio slope of (-15.0 +/- 2.8)e-4 TeV^-1 (-5.39 sigma) against hhfMB (N = 95,179). Two effects compound: (1) substituting etHFtowerSum > 3 GeV for the published >=3 HF towers/side coincidence (and omitting BSC halo + pixel cluster compatibility) produces a +5.17 sigma ultra-peripheral excess in bin 1 [0, 2.29] TeV (0.2556 +/- 0.0042 vs 0.2323 +/- 0.0016), inflating the 50-100% MB centrality fraction to 50.48% vs 48.50% (+4.41 sigma); and (2) applying the whole-event HiEcalRecHitSpikeFilter (minEt = 20 GeV) to Minimum Bias preferentially vetoes high-multiplicity central collisions (~5.5% in 0-10% vs ~0.2% in 50-100%), steepening the tilt. Excluding bin 1 reduces chi2/ndf to 64.20/53 = 1.211 (p = 0.139).

tests.name: Mean fractional dijet imbalance <(pT1 - pT2)/pT1> vs pT1 (archived Dec 2010 CMS HI CVS macro cross-check; PRC Fig. 12 PDF-only)

metrics.prc_fig12_published_status: arXiv:1102.1957 figures/deltaPtOverPt1_all_cent_20101223v1.pdf (Phys. Rev. C 84, 024906 Fig. 12, saved Dec 23, 2010) uses [120, 140, 160, 180, 240] GeV (centers 130, 150, 170, 210 GeV) and has no published numerical table or .C macro; not digitized per ARC policy.

tests.explanation: Matched bin-for-bin on [120, 130, 140, 170, 240] GeV (centers 125, 135, 155, 205 GeV) across 3 merged centrality classes (12 points), the Open Data fractional imbalance agrees with the archived Dec 13, 2010 CMS Heavy-Ion ROOT canvas deltaPtOverPt1VsPt.C (CmsHI/CVS_CmsHi) with chi2/ndf = 1.80/12 (stat, p = 0.9997) and 1.13/12 (stat+syst), max stat+syst pull -0.58 sigma, and centrality ordering 0.308 (30-100%) -> 0.343 (10-30%) -> 0.366 (0-10%); the 18-point [100, 240] GeV check gives chi2/ndf = 4.37/18 (stat) and 2.14/18 (stat+syst) (note: macro stat errors ~0.03-0.06 reflect uncorrelated TH1::Divide propagation, ~3x sample SEM). Final published Phys. Rev. C 84, 024906 Fig. 12 (deltaPtOverPt1_all_cent_20101223v1.pdf, Dec 23, 2010) uses [120, 140, 160, 180, 240] GeV (centers 130, 150, 170, 210 GeV) and has no numerical table or .C macro (not digitized); exact Open Data values on the PRC Fig. 12 binning (e.g. 0-10% [120, 140) GeV: 0.3625 +/- 0.0086) are exported in summary.json, fig10_fractional_imbalance_vs_pt1, hepdata/, and metrics.student_prc_fig12_bins.

tests.name: Balanced dijet fraction R_B(A_J < 0.15) vs N_part (PRC Fig. 11 / Open Data Fig. 9 text benchmarks)

metrics.intermediate_bins_note: 30-50%, 20-30%, 10-20% have no published table or .C macro (PRC Fig. 11 PDF figure only).

tests.explanation: No bin-by-bin table or archived .C macro exists for PRC Fig. 11 (Open Data Fig. 9), so only the explicit Sec. III.A.3 text benchmarks (~0.45 +/- 9% syst in 50-100%, dropping by ~factor 2 to ~0.225 +/- 11% syst in 0-10%) are tested without digitization. After applying HiEcalRecHitSpikeFilter to remove fake ECAL barrel-edge mono-jets from the inclusive pT1 > 120 GeV denominator, both endpoints agree within ~1 sigma: 50-100% is 0.3981 +/- 0.0515(stat) +/- 0.0339(syst) (43/108, pull -1.01 sigma stat-only / -0.70 sigma combined) and 0-10% is 0.2253 +/- 0.0147(stat) +/- 0.0191(syst) (196/870, pull +0.02 sigma stat-only / +0.01 sigma combined), with peripheral-to-central suppression ratio 1.77 +/- 0.26 (-0.91 sigma vs 2.0). Caveat: student systematics (6.4-9.9% rel.) evaluate JEC scale/tilt only and omit JER (6%) and underlying-event fluctuations (8%).

tests.name: Central 0-30% PbPb A_J median benchmark (Sec. III.B text)
tests.explanation: CMS-HIN-10-004 Section III.B (results_trackjet.tex line 52) states that A_J = 0.22 is the median of the 0-30% central PbPb A_J distribution. The student 0-30% dijet sample (N = 1,486) yields an interpolated histogram median of 0.2225 and exact event median of 0.2230 +/- 0.0051(stat) +/- 0.0058(syst), agreeing with 0.22 at +0.59 sigma (stat) / +0.39 sigma (stat+syst), with P(A_J < 0.22) = 0.489 +/- 0.013.
